verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an online government service portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks. The "EIN online assistant" is a timed, session-based form wizard with business hours and a 15-minute inactivity expiry, not an AI agent, and the probes found no AI-facing surfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
